title: story-028 assumes the phUSD top-up through a direct ERC4626YieldStrategy is rounding-scale, but the live USDC strategy's autoUSD redeem delivers a non-rounding 1.38 bps shortfall with no exit floor, which StableStakerV2 mints as unbacked phUSD
faithfulnessStory: story-028 (stable-staker storyDir; rationale correction routed to the stable-staker lane)
description: ERC4626YieldStrategy._disposeShares (:126-140) calls vault.redeem with no min-assets and discards the return. StableStakerV2 (stable-staker/src/src/StableStakerV2.sol:494-501, :574-580) measures the delivered delta and mints (target - delivered) as phUSD. story-028 scopes its slippageToleranceBps bound explicitly to AMM-backed strategies — the consumer NatSpec reads "A caller who sandwiches their own exit through an AMM-backed strategy keeps the sandwich profit ... It is bounded by the strategy's own `slippageToleranceBps` (which reverts below its floor)" (StableStakerV2.sol:496-499) and the story's Concerns name ERC4626MarketYieldStrategy's AMM. For DIRECT strategies the story instead assumes the top-up is rounding-scale (story-028 line 83, 'rounding-scale, not haircut-scale'; checklist line 310, tests at a non-integral share price). That assumption is broken on a live pool: the USDC strategy (0xaFDf8DeA…AB83, a direct ERC4626YieldStrategy over autoUSD) delivers previewRedeem, a proven static 1.38 bps below convertToAssets (16,356.04 vs 16,358.30 USDC), with no floor, and V2 mints that non-rounding shortfall as phUSD on every USDC autoAnnihilate. sDOLA (0x981c7BE1…B7EE) leaks rounding only (~1 wei/call), consistent with the story. V2 0xA6d3…B58F is the redeeming client of all three strategies (ECON-001). phUSD minted through V2 is real dilution (V2 emits Antimatter), not opportunity cost.
impact: Measured: sDOLA rounding-only (~1 wei/call); autoUSD static 1.38 bps discount (previewRedeem 16,356.04 vs convertToAssets 16,358.30 USDC) minted as phUSD on every USDC autoAnnihilate — dust, reward-bounded, accepted design. phUSD minted through V2 is real dilution (V2 emits Antimatter), not opportunity cost. A possible manipulation leg is unverified and is tracked only in escalationTrigger.
attackPath: A V2 staker with owed USDC-pool reward calls autoAnnihilate(USDC); netWanted = min(owed reward, principal).
V2 routes the exit through the live direct ERC4626YieldStrategy 0xaFDf…AB83; _disposeShares calls autoUSD.redeem with no min-assets and discards the return.
autoUSD delivers previewRedeem, ~1.38 bps below convertToAssets (measured, static).

V2 mints (target - delivered) as phUSD: a non-rounding shortfall story-028 assumed away for direct strategies, with no slippageToleranceBps bound on this strategy class. Dust today (~$2 per full exit), reward-bounded.
evidence: econ-scanner ECON-003; on-chain facts at block 26286995 (reports/18/econ-scanner-findings.json onChainFacts.wiring).
StableStakerV2 LIVE (CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet broadcast, 21/21 receipts), 20 AutoAnnihilated logs since block 26,000,000.
recommendation: Either add a delivery floor to ERC4626YieldStrategy._disposeShares (capture vault.redeem's return and require it >= previewRedeem(shares) * (1 - tolerance)), or correct story-028's rationale and add a consumer-side per-call cap on the phUSD top-up for direct-strategy pools. Route the rationale correction to stable-staker.
escalationTrigger: UNVERIFIED MANIPULATION LEG (moved out of attackPath by run-18 final review; not part of the proven finding): an actor might depress autoUSD destination-vault redeem output in the same tx/bundle when an exit exceeds autoUSD idle (707.5 USDC idle vs a 16,358 USDC position). No Tokemak source available locally and no fork manipulation probe was run. If proven, evaluate against the MEDIUM trigger below.

MEDIUM (measurable): a mainnet fork probe at the current block shows that, for a redeem above autoUSD idle, delivered USDC can be depressed by > 10 bps below convertToAssets through a same-tx action whose all-in cost is below 10 bps x the netWanted a single realistic V2 caller can request (total owed USDC-pool reward). Either condition alone does not trigger it.
MEDIUM if any live direct-strategy target is replaced by a vault whose previewRedeem/convertToAssets gap exceeds ~10 bps.
Re-weigh if V2 per-call top-up cap is removed/raised or netWanted becomes principal-bounded instead of reward-bounded.
